prompt: Character design sheet of Serin, a 20s female clockmaker and researcher. Full body turnaround: front view, side view, and back view, standing side-by-side on a plain white background. Serin has ash-brown short hair with one side neatly tied back. She has sharp black eyes, pale skin with slightly sun-kissed cheeks, thin neat eyebrows, and a mouth with a slight tension. She wears a stained white shirt with sleeves rolled up, a grey apron, and well-maintained old black shoes. A flat, worn-out Morse identification light is attached to her right ear. Modern 2D anime art style, clean line art, professional cel-shading, clear silhouette, high quality, flat lighting, no extra background elements.
